project.name: Mall AI After-sales Platform

agentRuntime: Task Runtime validates structured decisions, allow-lists, owner, TTL, budget and verified artifacts.
ActionProposal stores proposal skill separately from server-selected confirmation executor.
Confirmation reloads facts/hash and generates idempotency key; model cannot provide it.
architecture.javaAuthority: mall2 remains the authority for JWT, ownership, qualification, state machine, idempotency, transaction, Outbox and final write
architecture.ragBoundary: RAG provides policy evidence only; order/物流/资格/售后 facts come from Java
architecture.publicProjection: DTOs exclude prompt, reasoning, raw tool payload, RAG text, tokens and internal identifiers

metrics.retrieval: Dense/Hybrid/Rerank metrics above are local 52-case retrieval measurements, not answer accuracy

reliability.ledgerReconciliation: passed for deterministic, replay and slow ledgers (0 requests/0 tokens each)
reliability.duplicateConfirmation: covered by focused tests and showcase; no second Java write
reliability.staleProposal: covered by fact-change replay; stale proposal not submitted
reliability.runtimeDeadline: slow request completed within 240 seconds and before 300-second Nginx timeout

security.osv: local cached v2.5.1, CI-equivalent direct manifests, exit 0, No issues found
security.gitleaks: environment_blocked locally because binary is not installed; remote workflow remains required
security.secrets: no credentials, tokens, raw customer values or raw tool payloads added to tracked files

verified: focused/full FastAPI, deterministic manifest, local field runner, Java/Vue/Compose, deterministic/replay showcase, slow Nginx path
personalContribution.boundary: macrozheng/mall upstream commerce foundation remains upstream; AI Runtime/RAG/Java AI contracts/tests/evidence are project additions

upstreamBoundary: Apache-2.0 macrozheng/mall second development; mall2 business facts and final writes remain Java-authoritative
aiAssistance: AI-assisted implementation was reviewed against repository contracts; no claim is made that upstream code is original
